text:
Maria Chen: quick sync — runtime team is planning to add two fields to our telemetry events: `route_policy` (string) and `quota_bucket` (string). want to discuss SDK surface, rollout, and dashboard/backwards-compatibility. thoughts?

Ben Ortiz: big +1 on adding them, but we need a compatibility story. older SDKs will keep sending the old headers. we should carry the routing info via a header too so proxies and middleboxes see it.

Arjun Patel: agreed. proposal: SDKs add optional config `enable_routing_telemetry` default false. when enabled we emit `x-redwood-route-policy` and include the same values in the telemetry event payload. also add a lightweight shim that maps legacy `routing` param to the new header.

Priya Nair: runtime will start emitting the fields in v2 events, but we won't depend on SDKs for correctness during rollout. just need to avoid doubling cardinality in metrics. we should provide `policy_class` (coarse) + `route_policy` (fine) and instruct dashboards to prefer `policy_class` for high-cardinality counts.

Lena Gomez: cardinality is my main worry. if `route_policy` is a freeform string apps will explode our metrics. we should enforce allowed enums for `policy_class` (latency_prio, cost_prio, fallback) and hash/trim route_policy to a 8-char suffix when stored in high-cardinality metrics.

Arjun Patel: implementation sketch for SDKs (python/ts/go):
```
# python example
client = RedwoodClient(..., enable_routing_telemetry=True, routing_policy="latency_prio/shortseq")
# SDK will set header: x-redwood-route-policy: latency_prio/shortseq
```
TS: same config field in constructor. Go: env var `REDWOOD_ROUTING_TELEMETRY=1` as an alternative for infra.

Ben Ortiz: also need a server-side fallback: if header missing, runtime should attempt to infer `policy_class` from route hint or model family. but only as fallback — explicit header wins.

Maria Chen: privacy check — any concerns about surface-level PII in `route_policy`? Some customers put app ids in hints. Should we sanitize?

Priya Nair: yes sanitize. SDKs must strip anything matching UUIDs or email-like patterns from route_policy. runtime should also sanitize before storing. mark telemetry_v2 as "sanitized" in schema.

Lena Gomez: sampling plan: start with 100% for internal orgs, 10% for early customers, 1% global. SDK opt-in toggles will allow targeted pilots. we need a feature flag in console to flip sampling per tenant.

Arjun Patel: console UX note — show a simple toggle: "Include routing telemetry" per API key, with a sampling slider and preview of `policy_class` mapping. backend will write a per-key sampling header `x-redwood-telemetry-sample: 0.01`.

metrics-bot: FYI — dashboards need a new panel: "routing policy churn" (top policy_class by tokens) + alerts if unique route_policy count increases > 25% week-over-week.

Ben Ortiz: deprecation/compat timeline suggestion:
- t+0: announce schema v2 (route_policy + quota_bucket), docs and samples.
- t+2 weeks: SDKs ship opt-in `enable_routing_telemetry`.
- t+6 weeks: enable runtime emission in staging + console flag for 10% rollouts.
- t+12 weeks: enable broad rollout 100% but keep header fallback.
- t+26 weeks: audit and consider making it opt-out.

Maria Chen: sounds reasonable. who owns SDK changes? Arjun?

Arjun Patel: i'll take Python + TS. Ben, can your infra team do the Go env-var path?

Ben Ortiz: yep, infra will add env var + header mapping.

Priya Nair: runtime will add `policy_class` and `quota_bucket` to telemetry schema and implement sanitization. also we'll include `telemetry_version: v2` field.

Lena Gomez: i'll own sampling QoS and dashboard alerts.

Maria Chen: action items (short):
- Arjun: PRs for py/ts SDK config + header mapping, include sanitization rules. (due: 2w)
- Ben: Go env var + server header fallback, add header docs. (due: 2w)
- Priya: telemetry schema v2, sanitization + runtime fallback. (due: 3w)
- Lena: sampling plan + console toggle UX spec + alerts. (due: 2w)
- metrics-bot: create draft dashboard panel for review.

Maria Chen: also note: communicate to customers — emphasize privacy, opt-in pilot, no billing changes. I'll draft the announcement.

Ben Ortiz: one more thing — we should version headers like `x-redwood-route-policy-v=1` so intermediate proxies can route by version in future.

Arjun Patel: good call. SDKs will set versioned header.

Maria Chen: thanks everyone. i'll follow up with RFC + timeline in #announcements and raise a ticket for dev-ex docs. :thumbsup:
